concepts.description: A structural unit representing a component of the AUV system architecture.
A physical or simulated platform that hosts the AUV hardware and interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate, specifying values and events.
A logical component within the AUV system responsible for managing and directing system behaviour.
A basic data type defined within the AUV_Module to represent fundamental values.
A structured data type defined within AUV_Module that groups multiple named fields of potentially different types.
A named attribute within a CompositeType that holds a value of a specified type.
A named data field within an Interface that holds a specific typed piece of information.
A named signal or callable action defined within an Interface, optionally carrying parameters and return values.
A named computational unit defined within AUV_Module that takes inputs and produces an output.

instances.description: The top-level module representing the AUV system.
The AUV robotic platform contained in AUV_Module, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuator outputs.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operational commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
The Last Response Engine controller within AUV_Module that uses both the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface to autonomously control the AUV.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer values.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A Spherical Vector composite type recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A field of type real within SVec representing the radial component of a spherical vector.
A field of type real within SVec representing the polar component of a spherical vector.
A field of type real within SVec representing the azimuth component of a spherical vector.
A composite type recording obstacle-related values including ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng.
A field of type real within Obstacle representing the north-south relative distance.
A field of type real within Obstacle representing the east-west relative distance.
A field of type real within Obstacle representing the depth of the obstacle.
A field of type real within Obstacle representing the identifier of the obstacle.
A field of type SVec within Obstacle representing the heading of the obstacle.
A value of type SVec within the Sensors interface representing the AUV heading.
A value of type Obstacle within the Sensors interface representing a detected obstacle.
An interface defined by AUV_Module (intended as Inputs) containing events for task and mode control.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling the end of a task.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an obstacle collision manoeuvre.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a manual override manoeuvre.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a heading correction manoeuvre.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current velocity.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising heading.
A composite type recording close-proximity data including horiz_cda, vert_cda, and id.
A field of type real within Close representing the horizontal closest distance of approach.
A field of type real within Close representing the vertical closest distance of approach.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
